verdict.rationale: The skill-creator skill references being able to 'benchmark skill performance with variance analysis' and 'optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy,' implying some tooling exists for evaluating skill regressions, but there is no documentation of a formal test/eval suite, CI pipeline, or regression benchmarks applied to the shipped Anthropic Skills collection itself. Community reports (comm-6 through comm-14) describe unpredictable triggering behavior, suggesting no rigorous evals are evident in practice. Missing for 10: documented CI/test suite for the skills repo, published eval results or benchmarks per skill, evidence of automated regression checks before releases.
